name: parachutist
description: Pick up a parachutist: the collision pass marks the pickup and the parachutist's own handler shows the award and posts the next rescue bonus, vs MAME.
_grounding: Parachutist respawn delay (PARACHUTIST_RECORD+0x0E, 0xA8FE) poked to 1 at f640, so the slot spawns at golden ~f955. At f1000 its sprite entry is moved onto the player (PARACHUTIST_ENTRY 0xAA2E=0x84, +0x31 0xAA5F=0x78); the game's collision pass then writes the pickup mark 0xF0 into PARACHUTIST_RECORD 0xA8F0 ('responded', golden f1002), and runParachutistSlot runs showParachutistAward and, at state 0x10, postNextParachutistBonus.
